outcome.Summary: Created semver/semver.go implementing SemVer 2.0.0: a Version struct, Parse (optional v/V prefix, rejects leading zeros in numeric core and pre-release identifiers, empty identifiers, non-[0-9A-Za-z-] chars, and missing parts; allows leading zeros in build identifiers per the spec), String (canonical, no v prefix), Compare (numeric core, pre-release < release, identifier-wise numeric vs ASCII lexical ordering with numeric < alphanumeric and shorter list lower, build metadata ignored), and MustParse. Added semver/semver_test.go covering parse acceptance/rejection, String round-trips, the full spec precedence chain, and numeric-vs-alphabetic ordering. Verified with gofmt, go vet, and `go test ./... -count=1` — all pass.
